blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Deep research agents synthesize open-web evidence into long reports, but current benchmarks do not evaluate research centered on a source video. We introduce Video-Centered Deep Research Report Generation. Given a video and user request, an agent identifies research questions, retrieves external multimodal evidence, and produces an interactive report linked to relevant video moments. This task has direct practical value because it helps users locate relevant moments, verify claims, reproduce demonstrated procedures, and make informed decisions from video content. We present a skill-based workflow and OmniDR-Bench for this task. For evaluation, we propose Omni Atomic Rubric Trees (Omni-ARTs). Each tree contains three dimensions, 23 shared directions, and task-specific atomic binary criteria. The directions test audiovisual grounding, multimodal evidence use, and interactive presentation. Audited Rubric Construction (ARC) builds these trees through independent evidence collection, automated checks, behavioral calibration, and iterative human review. OmniDR-Bench contains 50 Chinese and English tasks across 19 realworld subcategories. It includes 6,414 criteria. Across 18 agent configurations, the best system scores 63.3 out of 100. Current agents still need broader content coverage, stronger causal and logical analysis across modalities, and more accurate citation support. We further analyze models, harnesses, skill configurations, video categories, and research trajectories. The code and data are released at https://github.com/marinero4972/OmniDR-Bench.
blocks.zh: 深层研究代理人将开放式网络证据合成长篇报告,但目前的基准并不评价以源视频为中心的研究. 我们介绍以视频为中心的深入研究报告生成。 根据视频和用户请求,一名代理人确定研究问题,检索外部多式联运证据,并制作与相关视频时刻相关的互动报告。 这项任务具有直接的实际价值,因为它有助于用户找到相关时刻,核实索偿要求,复制已显示的程序,并从视频内容作出知情的决定。 我们为这项任务提出了基于技能的工作流程和OmniDR-Bench。 为了评价,我们提议Omni原子Rubric树(Omni-ARTs). 每棵树包含三个维度,23个共同方向,以及任务特定的原子二进制标准. 方向检验视听定位、多式联运证据的使用和互动介绍。 经审计的Rubric Construction(ARC)通过独立收集证据,自动检查,行为校准,以及迭代的人类审查来建造这些树. OmniDR-Bench包含50项中英文任务,跨越19个现实世界亚类. 其中包括6 414项标准。 跨18个代理配置,最佳系统得分63.3分100分. 目前的代理人仍然需要更广泛的内容覆盖面,更强有力的因果和跨模式的逻辑分析,以及更准确的引用支持. 我们进一步分析模型、绳索、技能配置、视频类别和研究轨迹。 该代码和数据公布于https://github.com/marinero4972/OmniDR-Bench.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Videos teach knowledge, share opinions, demonstrate procedures, and advertise products through speech, imagery, and temporal context.
Compared with text, video natively preserves richer situational context, visible entities, spatial relations, and fine-grained actions that are difficult to verbalize completely.
These cues can reveal questions about mechanisms, credibility, alternatives, and practical use that a broad text topic may not expose.
Viewers may therefore need to locate relevant moments, verify claims and background, discover related material, or apply the content to a real decision.
These needs call for research that remains centered on the source video.
blocks.zh:
视频教授知识,分享观点,展示程序,并通过语音、图像和时间背景发布产品广告。
与文本相比,视频在本土上保留了更丰富的情境背景,可见的实体,空间关系,以及难以完全言语化的细腻动作.
这些提示可以揭示一个宽泛的案文专题可能不会暴露的机制、可信度、替代办法和实际用途等问题。
因此,观看者可能需要找到相关时刻,核实索赔和背景,发现相关材料,或将内容应用于真正的决定。
这些需要要求继续以源视频为中心进行研究。

blocks.en:
Existing agents address only parts of this goal.
Text-centered deep research agents produce cited reports through iterative web search and synthesis ( Java et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Qiao et al., 2025 ) .
They do not require the audiovisual or temporal evidence of a given video.
Video deep research combines source-video evidence with open-web retrieval and multi-step reasoning ( Liang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026a ; Gao et al., 2026 ; Fang et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) .
Its benchmarks mainly target difficult question answering (QA) tasks with short answers.
Text-image research report systems ( Shi et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Ma et al., 2026 ) synthesize multimodal web material without taking a source video or retrieved videos as research evidence.
Figure 1 locates these settings by input, research depth, and output form.
Table 1 further compares their operational boundaries.
No existing setting evaluates a complete research report that is organized around one source video and enriched by external multimodal evidence.

其基准主要针对难以回答的问题(QA)任务,并给出简短的答案.

blocks.en:
We introduce Video-Centered Deep Research Report Generation to fill this gap.
Given a source video and a user request, an agent identifies research-worthy claims, procedures, parameters, entities, and open questions.
It investigates webpages, documents, images, and related videos, then connects this evidence to relevant source moments.
The output is an interactive HTML report for understanding, verification, and practical application.
We implement a skill-based reference workflow with specialized media readers, anchor-conditioned research, evidence verification, and interactive rendering.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍以视频为中心的深度研究 报告生成以填补这一空白。
鉴于有源视频和用户请求,代理商确定值得研究的索赔、程序、参数、实体和未决问题。
它调查网页、文件、图像和相关视频,然后将这些证据与相关源点连接起来。
输出是一个交互式的HTML报告,用于理解,验证,以及实际应用.
我们实施了基于技能的参考工作流程,有专门的媒体读者、有主播条件的研究、证据核实和互动渲染。

blocks.en:
Evaluating this task is difficult because an open-ended report has no unique reference answer.
Valid reports may use different organizations and source sets ( Du et al., 2026a ; Sharma et al., 2025 ; Zhong et al., 2026 ) .
An evaluator must still distinguish citation volume from claim support and assess video grounding, cross-source reasoning, and the rendered artifact ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Leung et al., 2026 ; An et al., 2026 ) .
We address this challenge with Omni Atomic Rubric Trees (Omni-ARTs).
Each tree has three levels beneath the aggregate score: three quality dimensions, 23 shared diagnostic directions, and task-specific atomic binary criteria.
The hierarchy preserves comparable upper-level scores while testing the evidence needs of each task.
Reliable trees also require a sufficiently broad and independently verified evidence base.
We therefore propose Audited Rubric Construction (ARC), which collects multimodal evidence, screens candidate criteria, calibrates score behavior, and verifies every fact and criterion through iterative human review.
Together, Omni-ARTs and ARC define OmniDR-Bench .
Here, Omni denotes research across video, audio, image, and text, while DR denotes Deep Research.
blocks.zh:
评估这项任务很困难,因为一份不限成员名额的报告没有独特的参考答案。
有效报告可使用不同的组织和源集(Du等人,2026a;Sharma等人,2025;Zhong等人,2026)。
评估人员仍必须区分引用量与索赔支持,并评估视频的地基、交叉来源推理以及所提供的文物(Zhao等人,2026年;Leung等人,2026年;An等人,2026年)。
我们用Omni原子Rubric树来应对这一挑战。
每棵树在总分以下有三个级别:三个质量维度,23个共同的诊断方向,以及任务特定的原子二进制标准.
等级制度在测试每项任务的证据需求的同时,保留了可比的上层分数.
可靠的树木也需要足够广泛和独立核实的证据基础。
因此,我们提议审计Rubric Construction(ARC),它收集多种模式的证据,筛选候选标准,校准行为,并通过反复的人类审查来验证每一个事实和标准。
Omni-ARTs和ARC共同定义OmniDR-Bench.
而DR则表示深度研究。

blocks.en:
OmniDR-Bench contains 50 tasks across 19 subcategories and 6,414 criteria.
Experiments compare 18 configurations that pair models with agent harnesses, the execution frameworks that manage planning, context, delegation, and recovery.
The strongest system achieves 63.3 on the 0 0 – 100 100 rubric scale.
Presentation averages 81.8 points, while content and citation average only 45.4 and 47.8 points.
Under the shared report template, current agents satisfy presentation requirements more consistently than audited coverage, reasoning, and citation-support criteria.

实验比较了18种组合,将模型与物剂牵引物,即管理规划、环境、授权和恢复的执行框架结合起来。
最强系统实现63.3 0 – 100 100卢布比例.
列报平均值为81.8分,而内容和引用平均值仅为45.4和47.8分.
根据共享报告模板,目前的代理机构比审计范围、推理和引用支持标准更一致地满足列报要求。

blocks.en:
Our contributions are threefold. First , we propose Video-Centered Deep Research Report Generation, extending video deep research from short answers to complete and traceable reports. Second , we propose Omni-ARTs and ARC for fine-grained report evaluation and reliable benchmark construction. Third , we release OmniDR-Bench and a reference agent workflow.
We analyze models, agent harnesses, skill configurations, video categories, and long-horizon research trajectories.
blocks.zh:
我们的贡献有三个方面。 首先,我们提出以视频为核心的《深入研究报告生成》,将视频的深入研究从简短的答复扩大到完整和可追踪的报告。 第二,我们建议对Omni-ART和ARC进行精细报告评价和可靠的基准构建。 第三,我们发布OmniDR-Bench和参考代理工作流程.
我们分析模型,代理绳,技能配置,视频类别,以及长视距研究轨迹.

We accept a task only when video-only analysis is insufficient and generic web research cannot replace the source video.
Sufficient public evidence must also exist within a practical budget.

blocks.en: 2.2 Agent Workflow
blocks.zh: 2.2 工作流程

blocks.en:
We package the seven-stage agentic workflow as a high-level video-research skill , a reusable instruction and tool module.
It belongs to a suite of thirteen skills and invokes specialized video-reader and doc-reader modules as subagents.
The main agent carries the timeline, research anchors, external evidence, cross-source relations, unresolved questions, and report data across stages.
This shared state reduces repeated context loading and helps prevent goal drift in long trajectories ( Wang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
我们把七阶段的代理工作流程包装为高级视频研究技能、可重复使用的教学和工具模块。
它属于一套13种技能,并引用专门的视频阅读器和Doc阅读器模块作为子剂.
主要代理人携带时间线,研究锚,外部证据,跨源关系,未决问题,并报告各阶段的数据.
这种共享状态可以减少上下文的重复加载,并有助于在长轨中防止目标漂移(Wang等人,2026年).

blocks.en:
Figure 2 summarizes the seven stages from video intake through report validation and repair.
The agent first acquires the video and aligns visual observations with speech on one timeline.
It then selects request-relevant anchors with timestamps or frame evidence.
Parallel branches inspect webpages, images, videos, and documents.
Each branch returns structured evidence with provenance.
The main agent connects this evidence to the source video and synthesizes supported findings.
It writes structured report data and renders an interactive report with video-time navigation.
The final stage runs programmatic, citation, and required-process checks.
Failed checks return to evidence synthesis or report data for targeted repair.
Appendix D expands this control-flow overview with the reader roles, state fields, browser checks, evidence verification, and released budgets.
Appendix Figure 6 shows the final interactive artifact for one complete example.

blocks.en: 3.1 Video Collection and Query Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 录像收藏和查询建筑

blocks.en:
We select four families that reflect common reasons for researching a video.
Knowledge and viewpoint videos require explanation and verification.
Consumer and business videos support comparison and decision making.
Physical procedure videos require faithful reconstruction and diagnosis.
Creative and digital videos emphasize workflows, tools, and transferable practice.
Together, these families test distinct evidence needs and report outcomes.
We manually source and download candidate videos from YouTube and Bilibili.
Each retained video contains claims, steps, parameters, entities, or open questions that depend on visual or temporal context.
The fixed benchmark contains 50 Chinese and English tasks across 19 subcategories, with the full collection and curation protocol documented in Appendix E .

blocks.en:
Each task averages 128 criteria, giving 6,414 fine-grained checks.
One report takes roughly 2 hours, so one system requires about 100 agent-hours before repeated grading.
The deliberate 50-task scale covers four families and 19 subcategories while keeping the 18-configuration comparison tractable and favoring dense diagnosis over short-answer volume.
Appendix B lists all 19 subcategories, their definitions, and associated research needs.

blocks.en: 3.2 Omni Atomic Rubric Trees
blocks.zh: 3.2 奥姆尼原子润滑树

blocks.en:
An Omni Atomic Rubric Tree (Omni-ART) has three rubric levels beneath the final aggregate score.
The first level contains content, citation, and presentation.
The second level contains 23 shared diagnostic directions.
The third level contains task-specific criteria under each applicable direction.
The Omni scope covers video, audio, image, and text evidence and the relations among them.
Its directions therefore assess audiovisual faithfulness, cross-modal reasoning, multimodal source use, claim support, image-text correspondence, and video-time interaction.
This hierarchy supports comparison at shared upper levels without prescribing one report structure or source set.
Figure 5 in Appendix A shows the complete hierarchy, gate assignments, and model or deterministic evaluator types.
Each leaf is an atomic binary criterion with an expected outcome, evaluator, and evidence difficulty.
Semantic leaves bind to independent fact records; structural leaves bind to executable program or browser checks, making each decision auditable.
blocks.zh:
An Omni Atomic Rubric Tree(英语:Omni-ART)在最终汇总分数下有三个卢布级.
第一层包含内容,引文和演示文稿.
第二层包含23个共同诊断方向。
第三个层次载有每个适用方向下的具体任务标准。
Omni范围涵盖视频,音频,图像,以及文本证据及其之间的关系.
因此,其方向评估了视听的可靠性、跨模式推理、多式联运源的使用、索赔支持、图像文本通信以及视频时间互动。
这种等级支持在共享的上层进行比较,而不规定一个报告结构或源集.
附录中的图5 A显示完整的等级、大门分配和模型或确定性评价类型。
每个叶子都是一种原子二进制标准,具有预期的结果,评价者和证据难度.
语义叶绑定独立的事实记录;结构叶绑定可执行的程序或浏览器检查,使每个决定可以审计.

blocks.en:
We propose Audited Rubric Construction (ARC) to build and verify each Omni-ART.
Evaluated reports never enter ARC evidence acquisition or criterion generation.
This separation matters because evaluated reports can omit valid facts or favor the sources selected by one system.
ARC therefore builds an independent fact library before writing any criterion.
For each task, isolated agents first produce a Video Evidence Map of timestamped audiovisual facts.
They independently search webpages, documents, images, and related videos to build a Web Evidence Map.
This external multimodal search adds visual analogues, demonstrations, primary records, standards, and updated context that text search alone may miss.
ARC then connects the two maps through support, contradiction, update, explanation, comparison, and application relations.
The resulting fact library makes cross-modal evidence explicit before any rubric leaf is written.
Omni-ART scores the submitted report rather than compliance with the reference workflow in Section 2.2 .
Any internal process can receive credit when its final artifact satisfies the same criteria.
The fact library specifies salient research targets; it does not prescribe the report’s organization or an identical set of retrieved sources.
blocks.zh:
我们建议经过审计的Rubric建筑公司(ARC)建造和验证每个Omni-ART.
评价报告从未输入ARC证据获取或标准生成。
这种分离很重要,因为被评价的报告可以省略有效的事实,或者偏向一个系统所选择的来源.
因此,ARC在写出任何标准之前会建立一个独立的事实库.
对于每项任务,孤立的代理人首先制作一个时间印有视听事实的视频证据地图.
他们独立搜索网页,文档,图像和相关视频,以构建网络证据地图.
这种外部多式联运搜索增加了视觉模拟,演示,主记录,标准,以及仅文本搜索可能错过的更新上下文.
ARC然后通过支持,矛盾,更新,解释,比较,以及应用关系来连接这两个地图.
由此产生的事实库使交叉模式证据在书写任何文字叶之前就明确了。
Omni-ART对所提交的报告进行评分,而不是遵守第2.2节的参考工作流程。
任何内部程序如果最终产品符合同样的标准,都可以获得信贷。
事实图书馆具体规定了突出的研究目标;它没有规定报告的组织和一套相同的检索来源。

blocks.en:
Figure 4 summarizes the core ARC path from task specification to a versioned benchmark artifact.
S0 fixes the task scope and search routes to prevent evidence collection from drifting toward the broad topic.
S1 collects video evidence and external multimodal evidence in isolated branches to preserve provenance and keep either branch from copying the other’s framing.
It then reconciles support and conflict, removes irrelevant or redundant records, and retains salient evidence for the user request.
S2 converts this fact library and the report requirements into binary candidate criteria so that each leaf can be checked directly.
Generated criteria can be ambiguous, duplicated, weakly supported, or concentrated in a few directions.
S3 retains criteria that are grounded in evidence or executable behavior, atomic, complete enough to decide without unstated context, objectively worded, and judgeable by the assigned evaluator.
It also checks uniqueness, source support, and direction coverage.
S4 assembles and caps the retained leaves under the three dimensions and 23 directions so that high-volume directions do not dominate the score.

Shared bottleneck. Table 3 and Appendix Table 16 show a shared gap between presentation and research substance.
Under the shared interface template, presentation averages 81.8 81.8 points, compared with 45.4 45.4 for content and 47.8 47.8 for citation.
Across configurations, the unweighted mean of configuration-level direct-video-fact pass rates is 79.9 % 79.9\% .
The mean falls to 8.7 % 8.7\% for external evidence, 8.8 % 8.8\% for cross-source verification, and 5.0 % 5.0\% for multi-fact composition.
Fact coverage, causal analysis, and comparison average only 7.6 % 7.6\% , 9.5 % 9.5\% , and 4.6 % 4.6\% .
The dashboard additionally pools atomic decisions across configurations; under that weighting, the corresponding L0–L3 rates are 80.4 % 80.4\% , 9.0 % 9.0\% , 9.2 % 9.2\% , and 5.0 % 5.0\% , and the three coverage-direction rates are 7.9 % 7.9\% , 9.7 % 9.7\% , and 4.6 % 4.6\% .
Video faithfulness averages 92.4 % 92.4\% , but logical consistency and claim support reach only 21.2 % 21.2\% and 15.9 % 15.9\% .

blocks.en:
Finding sources is easier than using them. Appendix Table 17 exposes a recurring citation failure in the fine-grained directions.
For example, under Claude Code, GPT-5.6 Sol passes 98.0 % 98.0\% of source-count criteria and 93.5 % 93.5\% of multimodal-material criteria, but only 23.9 % 23.9\% of claim-support criteria.
Gemini-3.8-Flash passes 93.0 % 93.0\% of multimodal-material criteria, yet reaches 13.9 % 13.9\% on claim support.
Trace inspection shows that reports often collect links in a final Sources section without citing them beside the claims they should support.
Thus, retrieval volume does not imply evidence integration or citation closure between inline citations and source records.

Research trajectories and efficiency. Appendix Tables 23 and 24 report phase order across all 18 configurations.
Under Claude Code, median post-write search ranges from 33.3 % 33.3\% for GPT-5.6 Sol to 61.5 % 61.5\% for Claude Opus 5, while GLM-5.3 reaches 54.2 % 54.2\% with 15.5 15.5 median write blocks.
Eight configurations meet our interleaving rule, suggesting that drafting often exposes evidence gaps and triggers retrieval ( Wang et al., 2026 ) .
Interleaving alone does not ensure quality because productive evidence transfer matters more than trajectory length.

blocks.en:
Failure patterns. Appendices F.7 and H show that short traces leave evidence gaps, while long traces may repeat errors or fail to transfer evidence into the report.
Fragmented traces can still recover, so steps, tokens, and tool errors alone do not predict quality.

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en:
Deep research agents. Text agents produce cited reports through long-horizon retrieval and synthesis ( Qiao et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Du et al., 2026b ) .
Multimodal report agents add visual retrieval and interleaved output ( Geng et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ) , whereas video deep research connects source-video grounding with open-web search ( Gao et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) .
The former does not center research on a supplied video, and the latter mainly targets short-answer QA.
Our task uses the audiovisual timeline as the research backbone and returns a cited interactive report enriched with external multimodal evidence.
blocks.zh:
深研特务. 文本剂通过长距离检索和合成生成引证报告(Qiao等人,2025年;Li等人,2025年;Du等人,2026年b )。
多模式报告代理添加了视觉检索和互页输出(Geng等人,2025年;Shi等人,2026年;Ma等人,2026年),而视频深度研究则将源视频定位与开放网搜索连接起来(Gao等人,2026年;Liu等人,2026年b;Zhang等人,2026年b).
前者不把研究重点放在所提供的视频上,后者主要针对短答QA.
我们的任务利用视听时限作为研究的主干,并退回一份被引述的具有外部多式联运证据的交互式报告。

blocks.en:
Deep research benchmarks. Long-video and browsing benchmarks test temporally distributed understanding or open-web multi-step QA ( Fu et al., 2025 ; Meng et al., 2026 ; Liang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026a ) .
Text report benchmarks assess factuality, completeness, citation quality, and user intent ( Du et al., 2026a ; Sharma et al., 2025 ; Zhong et al., 2026 ) .
Multimodal, process, and rubric studies further examine visual retrieval, tool use, trajectory errors, report logic, and citation support ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Wan et al., 2026 ; Leung et al., 2026 ) .
OmniDR-Bench instead jointly evaluates video grounding, multimodal evidence, claim support, and interaction in complete reports.
blocks.zh:
深度研究基准. 长视频和浏览基准测试时间分布理解或开放网多步QA(Fu等人,2025年;Meng等人,2026年;Liang等人,2025年;Liu等人,2026年a).
文本报告基准评估了事实质量、完整性、引用质量和用户意图(Du等人,2026a;Sharma等人,2025年;Zhong等人,2026年)。
多式联运、工艺学和主题研究进一步审查了视觉检索、工具使用、轨迹误差、报告逻辑学和引用支持(Huang等人,2026年;Ye等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年;Wan等人,2026年;Leung等人,2026年)。
而OmniDR-Bench则联合评价视频定位、多式联运证据、索赔支持以及完整报告中的互动。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We introduce Video-Centered Deep Research Report Generation and OmniDR-Bench.
Omni-ART and ARC provide fine-grained evaluation grounded in audited multimodal evidence.
Across 18 configurations, the best score is 63.3 out of 100, exposing gaps in coverage, cross-modal reasoning, and claim support.
Future work targets better audiovisual use, efficiency, reasoning, and citations (Appendix I ).
blocks.zh:
我们介绍以视频为核心的深度调查报告生成和OmniDR-Bench。
Omni-ART和ARC提供了基于经审计的多式联运证据的精细评价。
在18个配置中,最佳得分是63.3分,暴露了覆盖面、跨模式推理和索赔支持方面的差距。
今后的工作目标是改进视听的使用、效率、推理和引用(附录一)。

blocks.en: A.3 Model-Judge Protocol
blocks.zh: A.3 示范法官协议

blocks.en:
Judge choice. GPT-5.6 Sol can inspect both text and images, which is required for semantic content, citation-support, and visual-presentation criteria.
It also supports bilingual instructions and structured outputs over long report contexts.
We use the same model and prompt settings for every evaluated system.
blocks.zh:
法官的选择。 GPT-5.6 常规 Sol可以检查文本和图像,这是语义内容,引用支持,和视觉呈现标准所要求的.
它还在长报告背景下支持双语指示和结构化产出。
我们使用同样的模式,每个被评价的系统都使用同样的设置。

blocks.en:
Decision protocol. The judge receives one atomic binary criterion, its evidence note, and the relevant report material.
It returns a binary decision, a short rationale, and supporting report evidence when available.
It runs at temperature zero.
Each non-gate model criterion is judged once.
Gate criteria are evaluated three times and decided by majority vote because a failed gate sets its direction score to zero.
M criteria evaluate directly observable properties without a model judge.
Their deterministic checks include browser interaction probes. Interpretation. Fixing the judge improves comparability across systems but does not remove model-specific bias.
The human study in Appendix A.5 verifies benchmark facts and criteria rather than every automatic report-level decision.
The separate study in Appendix A.6 measures agreement between automatic and human rubric decisions on generated reports.
Scores should therefore be interpreted under the released judge, prompts, and evaluator version.

blocks.en: A.5 Human Verification and Agreement
blocks.zh: A.5 人类核查和协定

blocks.en:
Human verification checks the two benchmark artifacts that define each task.
Fact-library review asks whether every retained fact is supported by the cited video moment or external source.
Criterion review asks whether every criterion is correct, judgeable, and bound to sufficient evidence.
Reviewers inspect the complete fact library and complete criterion set for each assigned task.
blocks.zh:

标准审查询问每一项标准是否正确、可判断、是否与充分证据相约束。
审查人员检查了完整的事实库,并为每一项分配的任务制定了完整的标准。

blocks.en:
The process contains two iterative validation rounds over a shrinking candidate pool.
In each round, multiple reviewers independently inspect every assigned package in the current pool.
Each fact and criterion is marked correct or incorrect under the supplied evidence and annotation rules.
The item correctness rate is the percentage of reviewed fact and criterion judgments marked correct.
Unanimity is the fraction of reviewed items for which all three reviewers assign the same label.
S6 aggregates these item judgments into package-level error profiles after each round.
Repairable packages are revised, packages with high or persistent artifact error rates are removed, and only accepted packages proceed to the next round.
This human quality-control loop reduces the candidate pool from 82 to 60 and then to the final 50 tasks.
Table 7 reports item-level rates before the repair and filtering decisions prompted by each round; the second-round value is not a post-correction error estimate for the released snapshot.
After final correction, reviewers sample 20 fact or criterion items from each of the 50 task packages.
More than 94.0 % 94.0\% of these 1,000 sampled items are marked correct.

blocks.en: A.6 Human Alignment on Generated Reports
blocks.zh: A.6 人类对生成报告的一致性

blocks.en:
We separately check the reliability of automatic rubric evaluation on generated reports.
We randomly sample 15 reports generated by Claude Opus 4.8 and 15 generated by GPT-5.6 Sol.
Three human raters independently evaluate each report under the released Omni-ART criteria.
They also assign a holistic score from 1 to 5 based on the report’s usefulness and trustworthiness.
Inter-rater agreement divides the decisions with three matching human labels by all comparable decisions.
Machine-to-human agreement divides automatic decisions that match the human majority label by all comparable decisions.
The two agreement rates are 93.0 % 93.0\% and 91.0 % 91.0\% , respectively.
Across all 50 tasks, Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.6 Sol score 60.7 60.7 and 54.9 54.9 with Omni-ART.
On the 15 sampled reports per model, their mean holistic ratings are 3.73 3.73 and 3.51 3.51 , respectively.
Across the 30 reports, Omni-ART scores correlate with mean holistic ratings at Spearman ρ = 0.64 \rho=0.64 .
Table 8 summarizes both atomic agreement and holistic validation.

blocks.en: B.1 Scenario Taxonomy
blocks.zh: B.1 情景分类

blocks.en:
The taxonomy starts from user needs rather than video genres.
It asks why a viewer would need research after watching and which audiovisual evidence makes the source video necessary.
Table 9 lists the four families, all 19 subcategories, and their typical research needs.
blocks.zh:
分类学起源于用户需求而不是视频流派.
它询问为什么观众在观看后需要研究,以及哪些视听证据使得源视频成为必要.

表9:全部情景分类和典型研究需求.

blocks.en:
The taxonomy covers three recurring user goals.
The first is efficient understanding, where the report locates important moments and explains difficult material.
The second is verification and extension, where external evidence checks claims and supplies missing context or alternatives.
The third is practical application, where the report adapts a procedure, recommendation, or decision to a concrete need.
These goals may coexist within one task.
blocks.zh:
该分类涵盖三个反复出现的用户目标.
第一是有效的理解,报告将确定重要的时刻,并解释困难的材料。
第二是核查和延期,由外部证据核查索赔和供应缺失的情况或替代办法。
第三是实际应用,即报告根据具体需要调整程序、建议或决定。
这些目标可在一项任务中共存。

blocks.en: B.2 Video Inclusion and Exclusion
blocks.zh: B.2 视频包容和排斥

blocks.en:
Inclusion criteria. A candidate video must contain several researchable claims, entities, procedures, parameters, or unresolved questions.
At least one important element must depend on visual, audiovisual, or temporal evidence rather than a title or transcript alone.
The topic must also have enough public external evidence for verification, comparison, explanation, updating, or application.
blocks.zh:
纳入标准。 候选视频必须包含若干可供研究的索赔、实体、程序、参数或未决问题。
至少一个重要因素必须取决于视觉、视听或时间证据,而不只是标题或记录。
这一专题还必须有足够的外部公开证据进行核查、比较、解释、更新或应用。

blocks.en:
Boundary tests. Each candidate is checked with the three acceptance tests in Table 10 .
The tests are applied to the complete video and query pair rather than to the video title alone.
For example, the pendant-light task depends on the shown socket, coupling, assembly, and product markings, while its safety assessment requires external standards and product evidence (Table 25 ).
These checks establish video dependence during curation; Table 5 studies capability groups and does not separately quantify the contribution of frames versus transcripts.
blocks.zh:
边界测试。 每个候选人在表10的三次验收中都经过检查。
测试应用于完整的视频和查询对对,而不是仅用于视频标题.
例如,圆柱光线任务取决于所显示的套接字、耦合、组装和产品标识,而其安全评估则需要外部标准和产品证据(表25)。
这些检查在校准期间确立了视频依赖性; 表5研究能力组,没有单独量化帧与笔录的贡献。

blocks.en:
Exclusion criteria. We reject direct lookups, transcript restatements, queries whose answer is independent of the source video, and cases with insufficient public evidence.
We also reject tasks that require private information, create avoidable safety risks, or depend on sources that cannot be stably identified.
blocks.zh:
排除标准。 我们拒绝直接查问、翻录、询问其答复独立于视频来源,以及公开证据不足的案件。
我们还拒绝那些需要私人信息、制造可避免的安全风险或依赖无法精确识别的来源的任务。

blocks.en: B.3 Fixed Data Snapshot
blocks.zh: B.3 固定数据快照

blocks.en:
The current benchmark contains 50 tasks and 17.1 hours of source-video content.
It includes 23 Chinese tasks and 27 English tasks drawn from YouTube and Bilibili.
The query set contains 7 general queries, 17 video-view queries, and 26 user-demand queries.
The four families are near-balanced, while subcategory findings remain descriptive because some scenarios have few tasks.

blocks.en: C.1 Three Query Forms

blocks.en:
We use three query forms to separate broad video understanding from focused research needs.
Their roles and final counts are shown in Table 11 .

blocks.en:
A general query requests broad research over the complete source video.
A video-view query selects one theory, case, claim, object, style, or procedure that is present in the video and asks for wider investigation.
A user-demand query starts from a plausible viewer’s concrete objective and uses the video as necessary evidence for that objective.
The two focused views may share a video anchor, but they differ in who defines the research boundary.

一个一般的查询要求对完整的源视频进行广泛的研究.
视频观看查询选择一个理论,案件,诉求,对象,风格,或者视频中包含的程序,要求进行更广泛的调查.
用户需求查询是从一个可信的观众的具体目标开始的,并将视频作为实现这一目标的必要证据。
两种重点观点可能共享一个视频主播,但它们在谁定义研究界限上有所不同.

blocks.en: C.2 Candidate Mining Pipeline
blocks.zh: C.2 候选采矿管道

blocks.en:
Step 1: audiovisual understanding. The video is probed for duration and language, divided into windows of length T win T_{\mathrm{win}} when needed, and processed by parallel video readers.
Timestamped speech, visible text, events, objects, and uncertain regions are merged into one dense understanding record.
This record is the only shared input to the two query miners.
blocks.zh:
步骤1:视听理解。 视频在持续时间和语言上被探测,在需要时分为长度的窗口T win T_{\mathrm{win}},并由平行的视频阅读器处理.
时标的语音,可见的文字,事件,物体,和不确定的区域被合并为一个密集的理解记录.
这个记录是对两个查询矿工的唯一共享输入.

blocks.en:
Step 2: independent query views. An anchor miner proposes video-view questions from the theories, claims, cases, visual objects, and procedures present in the record.
A demand miner uses the scenario playbook to propose realistic user-demand questions.
The demand miner considers six user roles, namely novice, practitioner, reproducer, decision maker, verifier, and troubleshooter.
blocks.zh:
步骤2:独立查询视图. 一名矿主从记录中的理论、权利主张、案例、视觉物体和程序中提出视频观看问题。
需求矿工使用情景剧本提出现实的用户需求问题.
开采者考虑6个用户角色,即新手、从业人员、复制人、决策者、核查人和故障排除人。

blocks.en:
Step 3: scoring and deduplication. Each miner returns five to ten candidates with a rationale and a confidence score.
Near duplicates within and across views are removed before ranking.
The video-view score is ( 𝜶 ( v ) ) ⊤ ​ 𝐬 ( v ) (\bm{\alpha}^{(v)})^{\top}\mathbf{s}^{(v)} .
Here, 𝜶 ( v ) \bm{\alpha}^{(v)} is the fixed weight vector and 𝐬 ( v ) \mathbf{s}^{(v)} contains video centrality, research value, searchability, and distinctness.
The user-demand score is ( 𝜶 ( u ) ) ⊤ ​ 𝐬 ( u ) (\bm{\alpha}^{(u)})^{\top}\mathbf{s}^{(u)} .
Here, 𝜶 ( u ) \bm{\alpha}^{(u)} is the fixed weight vector and 𝐬 ( u ) \mathbf{s}^{(u)} contains video necessity, external research need, concreteness, and demand fit.
The released vectors are listed in Appendix A.1 .
blocks.zh:
第3步:打分和减分. 每名矿工以理由和信心分数返回5至10名候选人。
在排名之前,删除了观点内部和相互之间近似重复的内容。
视频观看的分数是 (α (v)) ⊤ s (v) (\bm\alpha\(v)}) ^{\ top }\ mathbf{s}^{(v)}.
这里,\bm\alpha\(v)}是固定的重量矢量,s(v)\mathb{s\(v)}包含视频中心,研究价值,可搜索性,和独特性。
用户需求分数为 (α (u)) ⊤ s (u) (\bm\alpha\(u)}) ^{\ top }\ mathbf{s}^{(u)}.
这里, α (u)\bm\ alpha\(u)} 是固定的重量矢量 和 s (u)\ mathbf{s_(u)} 包含视频必要性, 外部研究需要, 具体性, 以及需求适中 。
释放的矢量列于附录A.1。

blocks.en:
Step 4: schema and language checks. The candidates are sorted within each view and written to a fixed JSON schema.
The output language follows the primary spoken language of the source video.
Automated checks verify the required keys, candidate count, score range, ranking order, and language consistency.
blocks.zh:
第4步:计划与语言检查. 考生在每一景区内进行排序,并写成固定的JSON计划.
输出语言遵循源视频的主要口语.
自动检查验证所需的密钥,候选数,分数范围,排名顺序,以及语言一致性.

blocks.en: C.3 Manual Acceptance Protocol
blocks.zh: C.3 人工接受议定书

blocks.en:
Annotators review the highest-ranked candidates against the full audiovisual record and the category-specific demand playbook.
A video-view query is retained only when it is broad enough to require synthesis, specific enough to remain centered on the source, and supported by searchable external evidence.
A user-demand query is retained only when three conditions hold together.
It must express a user’s own task, depend on details from the given video, and require substantial external research.
blocks.zh:
注释员根据完整的视听记录和特定类别需求游戏手册审查排名最高的候选人。
视频-视图查询只有在宽度足以需要合成,具体度足以保持以源头为中心,并有可搜索的外部证据支持的情况下,才会保留.
只有在三个条件结合在一起时,才保留用户需求查询。
它必须表达用户自己的任务,取决于特定视频的细节,并需要大量的外部研究。

blocks.en:
The strip-the-persona test detects demand queries that only attach a user label to a generic research topic.
Annotators remove the persona phrase and inspect the remainder.
If the remainder only asks whether the video’s claim is correct, the candidate is reclassified or rejected.
If it still describes a concrete action, decision, diagnosis, or reproduction problem, it remains a user-demand query.
blocks.zh:
脱口秀测试检测要求查询,只将用户标签附在一般研究课题上.
注释者删除一个短语,检查其余部分。
如果剩下的人只询问视频的诉求是否正确,候选人会被重新分类或驳回.
如果它仍然描述一个具体行动,决定,诊断,或复制问题,它仍然是用户需求查询.

blocks.en:
We reject candidates that merely ask for the next step in the video or request one isolated fact.
We also reject search recipes without a user need and requests that remain unchanged when the source video is swapped.
The final choice balances query quality with language, platform, family, and subcategory coverage.
blocks.zh:
我们拒绝那些只要求视频中下一步或要求一个孤立事实的候选人。
我们还拒绝用户不需要的搜索食谱,拒绝源视频互换时保持不变的请求。
最后的选择平衡了查询质量与语言,平台,家族,和子类覆盖.

blocks.zh: C.4 代表查询改革

Table 12 illustrates the difference among the three forms.
The focused examples are translated when the original task is Chinese.
blocks.zh:
表12说明了三种形式之间的差异。
重点例子在原任务为中文时翻译.

blocks.zh: 表12:代表查询表和保持每个查询以视频为中心的证据。

blocks.en: Appendix D Detailed Agent Workflow
blocks.zh: 附录D 代理工作流程

blocks.en: D.1 Roles and Shared State
blocks.zh: D.1 作用和共同国家

blocks.en:
The main agent owns the user goal, execution order, shared evidence state, report assembly, and repair decisions.
Specialized video-reader and doc-reader agents isolate long audiovisual and document contexts and return structured records.
Each record stores its modality, source, date, excerpt, associated research anchor, and verification state.
blocks.zh:
主要代理人拥有用户目标,执行令,共享证据状态,报告组装,以及修复决定.
专门的视频阅读和Doc阅读代理将长的视听和文件背景隔离,并归还结构化的记录。
每个记录都存储其模式,来源,日期,摘录,相关研究锚点,以及核查状态.

blocks.en: D.2 Seven Execution Stages
blocks.zh: D.2 七个执行阶段

blocks.en: Stage 1: acquire and inspect the video. The workflow resolves the video source, probes its duration, frame rate, resolution, and audio, analyzes the request, and prepares an execution plan.
blocks.zh: 第一阶段:获取和检查录像。 工作流程解决视频源,探究其持续时间,帧速率,分辨率,和音频,分析请求,并编制实施计划.

blocks.en:
Stage 2: build the audiovisual timeline. The video is divided into windows of T win T_{\mathrm{win}} seconds and assigned to parallel video-reader instances.
Each reader analyzes visual content and speech, and the main agent merges the results under absolute timestamps.
blocks.zh:
第二阶段:建立视听时间表。 视频被分为T win T_{\mathrm{win}} 秒的窗口,并被分配到平行的视频阅读器实例.
每个读者分析视觉内容和语音,主要代理将结果在绝对时间戳下合并.

blocks.en:
Stage 3: select research anchors. The main agent selects request-relevant claims, entities, procedures, and parameters from the timeline.
Each anchor retains its timestamp, transcript evidence, or frame crop and states whether the goal is to explain, compare, verify, update, or apply the video content.
blocks.zh:
第3阶段:选择研究主播. 主要代理人从时限中选择与请求相关的债权,实体,程序和参数.
每个主播保留其时间戳,笔录证据,或帧裁剪,并说明目标是解释,比较,核实,更新,还是应用视频内容.

blocks.en:
Stage 4: research external multimodal evidence. Anchor-specific branches search webpages, images, videos, and documents in parallel.
The workflow opens sources beyond snippets, assigns related videos to a video-reader , and assigns long or visual documents to a doc-reader .
Each branch returns evidence records with provenance, excerpts, media, dates, and confidence.
blocks.zh:
第4阶段:研究外部多式联运证据。 Anchor特定分支平行搜索网页,图像,视频,文档.
工作流程打开超出片段的源头,将相关视频指定给视频阅读器,将长文件或视觉文件指定给文档阅读器.
每个分支将证据记录与出处,摘录,介质,日期,以及信心一起返回.

blocks.en:
Stage 5: connect evidence and synthesize. The workflow relates video and external evidence through support, contradiction, update, explanation, comparison, and application.
Corrective and comparative findings require independent support before the main agent converts them into report claims.
blocks.zh:
阶段5:连接证据和合成. 工作流程通过支持,矛盾,更新,解释,比较,应用,将视频和外部证据联系起来.
纠正和比较结论需要独立支持,然后由主要代理人将其转化为报告索赔。

blocks.en:
Stage 6: write data and render the report. The agent incrementally writes the overview, timeline segments, research findings, media, and sources into a structured window.DATA object.
After schema and asset checks, a fixed renderer creates a dual-pane report with the source video, time-aligned notes, evidence, citations, and clickable timestamps.
blocks.zh:
第6阶段:编写数据并编写报告。 代理将概述、时间段、研究结果、媒体和来源逐步写入结构化窗口。 DATA 对象.
经过计划和资产检查后,一个固定的渲染器会制作一个双面报告,上面有源视频,时间对齐的注释,证据,引用,以及可点击的时间戳.

blocks.en:
Stage 7: validate, repair, and deliver. Programmatic checks validate report data, local assets, citations, rendering, and browser interactions.
Fresh-context evidence checks reopen cited sources and test whether they support the associated claims.
Required-process checks confirm inspection of related videos, use of visual evidence, and verification of key data.
The main agent repairs unsupported claims, replaces unreachable evidence, reruns affected checks, and delivers the validated report.
blocks.zh:
第7阶段:验证、修理和交付。 程序检查验证报告数据、本地资产、引用、渲染和浏览器互动。
新的文字证据检查重新打开了所引用的来源,并检验它们是否支持相关的索赔。
所需流程检查确认检查有关视频、使用视觉证据和核实关键数据。
主代理修理无凭据索赔,更换无法接触的证据,重新运行受影响的检查,并交付审定报告.

blocks.en: D.3 Released Budgets
blocks.zh: D.3 已公布的预算

blocks.en:
The reference configuration uses B web B_{\mathrm{web}} and B video B_{\mathrm{video}} for minimum external-source and related-video counts.
It uses B doc B_{\mathrm{doc}} and B anchor B_{\mathrm{anchor}} for minimum document and per-anchor source counts.
Table 6 reports their released values.
blocks.zh:
参考配置使用 B web B_{\mathrm{web}} 和 B video B_{\mathrm{video}} 来进行最小的外部源和相关视频计数.
它使用 B doc B_{\mathrm{doc}} 和 B 锚 B_{\mathrm{anchor}} 来进行最小文档和每个锁定源计数.
表6报告了公布的数值。

blocks.en: Appendix E Benchmark Construction and Annotation
blocks.zh: 附录E 基准构建和说明

blocks.en: E.1 Seven-Stage Construction and Human Curation
blocks.zh: E.1 七层建筑和人类修饰

blocks.en:
Audited Rubric Construction (ARC) turns each accepted video–query pair into a validated task package through seven stages, S0–S6.
The stages form an iterative quality-control loop: S0–S4 construct the task artifacts, S5 detects failures through automatic and human validation, and S6 either repairs the package or removes it before the next round.
Table 13 summarizes this flow.
blocks.zh:
经审计的Rubric Construction(ARC)将每个被接受的视频-query配对变为经过7个阶段的经过验证的任务包,S0-S6.
阶段形成迭代质量控制环:S0–S4构造任务文物,S5通过自动和人验证检测故障,S6要么修复包件,要么在下一轮前移除包件.
表13总结了这一流量。

blocks.en: Table 13: The seven ARC stages, their artifacts, and their quality controls.
blocks.zh: 表13:ARC的七个阶段,它们的文物,以及它们的质量控制.

blocks.en:
S0–S4 first produce 82 candidate task packages.
During S5, reviewers inspect the facts and criteria in each package and record incorrect, unsupported, ambiguous, or unjudgeable items.
S6 aggregates these findings at the package level: repairable issues are routed back to the stage that produced them, while packages with high or persistent artifact error rates are excluded rather than carried into evaluation.
Only accepted or successfully repaired packages proceed to the next validation round.
The first human-validation and S6 pass reduces the pool from 82 to 60 packages; the next pass yields the final 50-task benchmark.
Thus, 82-to-60-to-50 is the attrition trace of the S5–S6 human quality-control loop, not a separate selection based on scores obtained by compared systems.
blocks.zh:
S0–S4首先制作82套候选任务包.
在S5期间,审查人员检查每个包中的事实和标准,记录不正确、不支持、模棱两可或无法判断的项目。
S6在包一级汇总了这些发现:可修复的问题被追溯到产生这些结果的阶段,而具有高或持续文物误差率的包则被排除在外,而不是纳入评价.
只有被接受或成功修复的软件包才能进入下一个验证回合。
第一次人类验证和S6通过将游泳池从82个包减为60个包;下一次通过则产生最终的50个任务基准.
因此,82比60比50是S5–S6人质量控制循环的减员痕迹,而不是根据比较系统获得的分数单独选择.

blocks.en: E.2 Independent Evidence Acquisition
blocks.zh: E.2 获取独立证据

blocks.en:
ARC separates video reading from external retrieval so that neither branch can copy the other’s framing.
The two evidence maps are reconciled only after each branch records its own observations and provenance.
blocks.zh:
ARC 将视频读取与外部检索分开, 这样两个分支都无法复制对方的帧 。
两张证据地图只有在每个分支记录自己的观察和出处后才进行核对.

blocks.en:
Video evidence map. S1a runs without web access and records timestamped speech, visible text, entities, actions, procedures, parameters, and unresolved visual details.
Long videos are split into windows of length T win T_{\mathrm{win}} for parallel audiovisual reading.
Every retained video fact has a time reference and its origin is marked as video.
blocks.zh:
视频证据地图. S1a运行时没有网络访问和记录时间戳的语音,可见文本,实体,动作,程序,参数,以及未解决的视觉细节.
长视频被分割成长度的窗口 T 赢得 T + mathrm{ win}用于平行的视听阅读.
每个保留下来的视频事实都有时间参考,其来源被标记为视频.

blocks.en:
Web evidence map. S1b has no path to the source video and searches six routes in isolated sessions.
The routes cover named entities, primary provenance, concepts and standards, relevant people, analogous cases, and event timelines.
Retrieval includes webpages, documents, images, and related videos because visual demonstrations and comparisons may not be recoverable from text alone.
Each route records atomic claims, canonical URLs, source type, publication date, and a supporting quotation.
Discovered entities are fed into later rounds.
Collection stops after two consecutive saturated rounds or at the configured round limit.
Saturation requires both new relevant claims and new relevant source domains to fall below their thresholds.
blocks.zh:
网易证据地图. S1b没有途径在孤立的会话中找到源视频和搜索六条路线.
路线包括点名实体、主要来源、概念和标准、相关人员、类似案件和事件时间表。
检索内容包括网页、文档、图像和相关视频,因为仅从文本中可能无法进行视觉演示和比较。
每个路由记录原子主张,犬形URL,源类型,发布日期,以及一个支持引文.
被发现的实体被输入以后的回合。
收藏在连续两轮饱和后或在配置的圆限时停止.
饱和要求新的相关索赔和新的相关源域都低于其阈值。

blocks.en:
Reconciliation. S1c merges semantically equivalent statements while retaining alternate wording and provenance.
Numerical or factual disagreements are preserved as explicit conflict edges rather than silently resolved.
Confidence is assigned by evidence structure.
A record is verified when it has at least two independent domains or a suitable primary source.
It is single-source when it has one source, disputed when supported records conflict, and unavailable when no usable source is found.
blocks.zh:
调和. S1c在保留替代措辞和来源的同时,还合并了类同的语句.
数字或事实上的分歧被保留为明显的冲突边缘,而不是默默解决。
信心由证据结构确定。
当一个记录至少有两个独立域或一个合适的主要来源时,就予以核实。
当它有一个来源时,它是单一来源的,当支持的记录冲突时,它会引起争议,当找不到可用的来源时,它就不存在。

blocks.en:
The evidence record is the auditable interface between retrieval and rubric construction.
Table 14 shows the information preserved for each atomic claim.
These fields ground later Omni-ART criteria in sources, video locations, verification states, relevance labels, and unresolved conflicts.
blocks.zh:
证据记录是可审计的检索与标题构造的接口.
表14显示为每项原子索赔保留的资料。
这些字段后来根据Omni-ART标准在源、视频地点、核查状态、相关标签和未解决的冲突进行。

blocks.en: Table 14: Evidence-record schema for generating and auditing source-bound Omni-ART criteria.
blocks.zh: 表14:生成和审计源约束Omni-ART标准的证据记录计划。

blocks.en: E.3 Rubric Tree Leaf Generation and Screening
blocks.zh: E.3 红树叶的产生和筛选

blocks.en:
S2 maps evidence types to candidate templates for fact coverage, faithfulness, causal explanation, comparison, cross-source linkage, citation support, and report behavior.
This mapping ensures that the rubric tests both source-video understanding and the use of external multimodal evidence.
Each model-judged atom contains a fact identifier, and each machine atom without a fact identifier states the reader-facing impact of failure.
Criteria are phrased as binary questions with a fixed expected polarity.
Compound statements and important numbers are split into separate atoms.
blocks.zh:
S2将证据类型映射到候选模板中,用于事实覆盖,忠实,因果解释,比较,跨源链接,引用支持,以及报告行为.
这种绘图确保了对源视频的理解和对外部多式联运证据的使用进行标点测试。
每个模型判断的原子都包含一个事实标识符,每个没有事实标识符的机器原子都说明了失败的读取-渲染影响.
标准是二进制问题,具有固定的预期极性。
复合语句和重要数字被分为独立的原子.

blocks.en:
S3 removes candidates that lack evidence, contain several claims, use subjective language, duplicate another item, admit several interpretations, or fall outside their assigned direction.
Difficulty is computed from evidence structure rather than predicted by a model.
L0 requires one source-video fact, L1 requires external evidence, L2 requires independent verification or conflict handling, and L3 requires composition across distinct facts.
blocks.zh:
S3删除了缺乏证据,包含数项诉求,使用主观语言,重复另一项目,承认数项解释,或者超出指定方向的考生.
难度是从证据结构而不是模型预测出来的。
L0需要一个源视频事实,L1需要外部证据,L2需要独立核查或冲突处理,L3则需要不同事实的构成.

blocks.en:
S4 places the retained criterion leaves into stable direction slots.
An absent direction must have an instance-specific N/A reason.
Caps prevent high-volume directions from overwhelming the remaining evaluation criteria.
The fixed snapshot contains 4,060 content atoms, 1,234 citation atoms, and 1,120 presentation atoms.
It contains 2,363 L0, 1,475 L1, 2,167 L2, and 409 L3 atoms.
The retained rubrics reference 3,102 task-local fact identifiers, averaging approximately 62 per task.
blocks.zh:
S4将保留的标准叶片放入稳定方向槽.
没有指示必须具有具体实例的不适用理由。
帽子防止高容量方向压倒其余的评价标准。
固定的快照包含4,060个内容原子,1,234个引用原子,以及1,120个演示原子.
它包含2,363 L0,1,475 L1,2,167 L2和409 L3原子.
保留的标题参考了3 102项任务-当地事实标识,平均每项任务约62项。

blocks.en: E.4 Validation at Three Levels and Human Review
blocks.zh: E.4 三级鉴定和人文审查

blocks.en:
Static validation. Sixteen checks cover schema validity, identifiers, direction membership, logic compatibility, evidence binding, gates, and presentation impact.
They also test machine-check eligibility, subjective wording, duplicates, direction coverage, and difficulty balance.
The remaining checks examine source concentration, empty-report behavior, direction boundaries, and language consistency.
Errors must be resolved before release, while warnings require an explicit review decision.
The empty-report check runs every deterministic atom against a valid but content-free report and rejects criteria that award unsupported credit.
blocks.zh:
静态验证. 16项检查涵盖计划有效性、识别符、方向成员、逻辑兼容性、证据约束、大门和列报影响。

blocks.en:
Human validation. Reviewers inspect the facts and criteria in each assigned candidate package.
Each package is independently checked by multiple reviewers in the current validation pool.
For each fact and criterion, reviewers mark whether it is correct under the provided source evidence and annotation rules.
Majority vote determines each item label, and three-reviewer unanimity measures consistency.
Round one records 64.0% item correctness and 77.0% unanimity.
S6 uses the resulting package-level error profiles to repair viable packages and exclude high-error packages before the next round.
Round two records 87.0% item correctness and 81.0% unanimity on the surviving pool.
Its feedback drives the final repair and filtering pass before the snapshot is frozen.
Appendix A.5 reports the protocol and results.

blocks.en:
The ablation suite fixes GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Code, the report contract, and 15 source tasks.
It also fixes the iteration limit, timeout, and retry policy across all variants.
Actual steps, elapsed time, and token use remain outcomes of the agent’s behavior under each capability configuration.
The frozen subset contains four tasks from each of the first three major families and three from the fourth.
It also contains ten YouTube videos and five Bilibili videos.
Evaluating every configuration on every source produces 75 paired runs.
Configuration order is rotated within each task to reduce time and changing-web confounds.
Table 5 defines the five cumulative capability settings and reports their results.
The fixed interface template contains no procedural instructions.
Video processing includes transcription, frame extraction, and source-video multimodal reading.
Text web research adds search and webpage reading, while multimodal retrieval further adds image and video search, download, and inspection.
The video-research skill adds the high-level workflow for anchor discovery, multi-source investigation, synthesis, rendering, and validation.
The final two rows measure the effect of adding high-level orchestration when all atomic skills are already available, including the extra research and verification it induces.
They do not hold realized compute constant because the model decides how much of the fixed allowance to use.
The comparison therefore estimates the workflow’s deployed quality and cost trade-off.

Low-scoring traces appear at both extremes, including short under-researched runs and long runs dominated by repeated repair or weak evidence integration.
blocks.zh:
分布表明,较长的追踪时间对于更强有力的报告既无必要,也不足。
高分系统往往将持续获取证据与成功地将证据输入报告结合起来。
低评分的痕迹出现在两个极端,包括研究不足的短跑和以重复修复或证据整合薄弱为主的长跑.

blocks.en:
Long but weakly converted research. One Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash run uses 549 steps, 272 tool calls, 31.6 million runner-reported tokens, and 4.6 hours, yet scores 63.1.
The trace contains extensive video work, search, and report editing, but much of the acquired evidence does not become supported report claims.
blocks.zh:
长期但微弱的转化研究. 1个Quen3.8-Omni-Flash运行使用549步,272个工具呼叫,3160万个跑者报信符,以及4.6小时,然而成绩为63.1分.
追踪包含广泛的视频工作、搜索和报告编辑,但获得的证据大多没有成为报告索赔的佐证。

blocks.en:
Organized delegated research. One GPT-5.6 Sol run under Claude Code uses 226 main-agent steps, 167 tool calls, and 7.9 million tokens and scores 71.5.
Its main trace uses explicit task checkpoints and 24 subagent calls for media reading, retrieval, and verification.
This case shows how delegation can keep the main context focused while retaining a long evidence path.
blocks.zh:
组织委托研究. 一个GPT-5.6 索尔在克劳德代码下运行,使用226个主代理步骤,167个工具呼叫,以及790万令牌和71.5分.
其主要追踪手段是设置明确的任务检查站和24次副代理,要求媒体阅读、检索和核查。
这一案件表明,代表团如何在保持漫长的证据路径的同时,保持主要背景的重点。

blocks.en:
Clean but shallow execution. One Qwen3.7-Max run under Codex uses 83 steps and 53 tool calls with no recorded tool error but scores 31.2.
The execution is stable, yet the limited research path leaves the report thin in evidence coverage and cross-source analysis.
blocks.zh:
干净但浅的处决。 在Codex下运行的1个Qune3.7-Max使用83步和53个工具调用,没有记录工具错误,但得分31.2.
执行是稳定的,然而有限的研究路径使得报告在证据覆盖面和跨源分析上都比较薄弱.

blocks.en:
Repeated failure without repair. One Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus run uses 376 steps and 194 tool calls, records 126 tool errors, and scores 38.6.
Many errors repeat the same invalid validation path instead of changing the command or locating the correct file.
This loop consumes budget without improving the report.
blocks.zh:
屡屡故障而未修. 1 Quen3.5-Omni-Plus运行使用376步和194个工具调用,记录126个工具错误,分数38.6.
许多错误重复相同的无效验证路径,而不是更改命令或定位正确的文件.
这种循环消耗预算而不改进报告。

blocks.en:
Fragmented but recoverable execution. One GPT-5.6 Sol run under OpenClaw uses 586 steps, 324 tool calls, and 16 tool errors and scores 72.1.
The trace decomposes retrieval and verification into many shell calls but still delivers a strong report.
This contrast shows why trajectory length alone cannot distinguish productive iteration from fragmentation.
blocks.zh:
分散但可收回的执行。 一个GPT-5.6 在OpenClaw下运行的Sol使用586步,324个工具呼叫,以及16个工具错误和得分72.1.
踪迹将检索和核实分解成许多空壳呼叫,但仍能提供强烈的报告.
这一对比表明,轨迹长度本身为何无法区分生产迭代和碎裂。

blocks.en:
These cases were selected after the aggregate analysis to illustrate recurring mechanisms.
They are not used as substitutes for system-level statistics.
blocks.zh:
这些案件是在综合分析之后选定的,以说明反复出现的机制。
它们不被用作系统一级统计的替代品。

blocks.en: G.1 Evaluated Agent Instruction

blocks.en:
Every evaluated system receives the same deliverable request in the language of the source video.
The instruction identifies the local source video, its public source URL, the user focus, and the output directory.
It does not expose the evidence map, criterion atoms, or evaluator decisions.

该指令确定了本地源视频,其公共源URL,用户焦点,以及输出目录.

blocks.en: Evaluated Agent Instruction Use the video-research capability to conduct deep research on [VIDEO] . The public source is [SOURCE URL] . Focus on the following user need: [QUERY] . Produce an illustrated and source-cited HTML report in [OUTPUT DIRECTORY] . Retain detailed audiovisual notes, but make the search, analysis, and discussion answer the stated focus.

The high-level skill then supplies the seven-stage workflow described in Section 2.2 .

blocks.en: G.2 Query Mining Prompts
blocks.zh: G.2 查询采矿提示

Two isolated roles then receive that same record and the scenario label.
The video-view role is instructed as follows.

之后两个孤立的角色收到同样的记录和情景标签.
视频观看角色指示如下.

blocks.en: Video-View Query Mining Prompt Propose five to ten research directions that originate from claims, theories, cases, procedures, parameters, or visual objects in this video. Each direction must require the given video, benefit from substantial external research, and remain broad enough for a report. Return the query, a video-grounded reason, and a confidence score.

blocks.en: Video-View Query Mining Prompt
blocks.zh: 视频视频查询

blocks.en: Propose five to ten research directions that originate from claims, theories, cases, procedures, parameters, or visual objects in this video. Each direction must require the given video, benefit from substantial external research, and remain broad enough for a report. Return the query, a video-grounded reason, and a confidence score.
blocks.zh: 提出5到10个研究方向,这些方向源于本视频中的说法,理论,案例,程序,参数,或视觉物体. 每个方向都必须需要给定的视频,从大量的外部研究中受益,并保持足够宽广的报道. 返回查询,视频基于理由,以及信心分数.

blocks.en: The user-demand role receives a different contract.
blocks.zh: 用户需求角色收到不同的合同.

blocks.en: User-Demand Query Mining Prompt Propose five to ten realistic viewer needs involving a decision, diagnosis, reproduction, verification, or application problem. Each query must express the user’s own task, depend on concrete audiovisual details in this video, and require external evidence beyond the video. Do not create a generic fact-check request by adding a superficial persona. Return the query, a video-grounded reason, and a confidence score.
blocks.zh: 用户-要求查询采矿即时建议5至10个现实的查看器需要,涉及决定、诊断、复制、核查或应用问题。 每个查询必须表达用户自己的任务,取决于录像中的具体视听细节,并且需要视频以外的外部证据。 不通过添加表面人物来创建通用事实检查请求。 返回查询,视频基于理由,以及信心分数.

blocks.en: User-Demand Query Mining Prompt
blocks.zh: 用户需求查询提示

The schema checker enforces separate arrays, five to ten candidates per view, a score in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , descending order, and language consistency.

schema检查器执行单独的数组,每个视图有5到10名候选人,在[0,1] [0,1]中得分,降序,语言一致性.

blocks.en: G.3 Independent Evidence Prompts
blocks.zh: G.3 独立证据提示

blocks.en:
The video-side collector is explicitly denied web access.
It is asked to transcribe the complete video, inspect frames and visible text, and emit one checkable claim per JSONL row with an absolute timestamp.
It must preserve the video’s own wording and uncertainty instead of correcting claims from memory.
blocks.zh:
视频侧集器被明确拒绝上网.
它被要求将完整的视频转录下来,检查帧和可见文本,并且每JSONL行发出一份带有绝对时间戳的可核对索赔。
它必须保留录像本身的措辞和不确定性,而不是纠正记忆中的说法。

blocks.en:
The web-side collectors receive only the query, domain, language, route description, and accumulated search seeds.
They cannot access the source video or another route’s workspace.
Each collector searches one of six routes covering entities, provenance, concepts, people, analogues, and timelines.
It must open candidate sources, copy supporting text, mark source type and date, and preserve unavailable or conflicting evidence.
blocks.zh:
网络边的采集器只接收查询,域,语言,路由描述,以及累积的搜索种子.
他们无法访问源视频或其他路线的工作空间。
每个收集器搜索6条路线中的一条,包括实体、来源、概念、人、模拟和时间表。
它必须打开候选来源,复制支持文本,标明来源类型和日期,并保存无法获取或相互矛盾的证据。

blocks.en: Atomic Evidence Record Contract Emit one JSON object per atomic claim. Include claim , type , origin , video_ref , sources , and conflicts_with . Each source contains a canonical URL, source tier, publication date, and verbatim supporting quotation when available. Do not assign identifiers, confidence, difficulty, or relevance because later stages compute or adjudicate them.
blocks.zh: 原子证据记录合同 每原子索赔一次释放一个JSON对象. 包括索赔、类型、来源、视频_ ref、来源和冲突。 每个来源都包含一个词库URL,源级,发布日期,以及可用时的逐字记录支持引文. 不指定标识符、信任度、难度或相关性,因为以后各阶段会计算或裁定。

Each source contains a canonical URL, source tier, publication date, and verbatim supporting quotation when available. blocks.en: G.4 Rubric and Judge Prompts
blocks.zh: G.4 Rubric和法官提示

blocks.en:
The atom generator receives the task specification and evidence records but no evaluated report.
It produces binary criteria that ask one checkable question and bind semantic criteria to fact identifiers.
The screening prompt rejects unsupported, compound, subjective, duplicate, ambiguous, or misassigned criteria.
blocks.zh:
原子生成器收到任务说明和证据记录,但没有评估报告。
它产生二进制标准,提出一个可核查的问题,并将语义标准绑定在事实识别符上.
筛选迅速拒绝不支持、复合、主观、重复、模棱两可或误用的标准。

blocks.en:
At evaluation time, the judge receives one atom, its evidence note, and only the report material needed for that decision.
It must return Yes, No, or N/A with a short report-grounded rationale and quoted evidence when present.
It is instructed not to award credit from parametric knowledge or from evidence absent from the report.
J and M criteria use the same expected polarity and identifier scheme.
Model-judged gates use three independent votes.
blocks.zh:
在评估时,法官收到一个原子、其证据说明以及该决定所需的报告材料。
它必须返回 " 是 " 、 " 否 " 或 " 否 " ,并附有简短的报告理由和所引用的证据。
指示它不从辅助知识或报告未提供的证据中给予信贷。
J和M标准使用相同的预期极性和识别特征方案.
模型判官的大门使用3张独立票.

blocks.en: Atomic Rubric Judge Contract Given one binary criterion, its evidence note, and the relevant report material, decide whether the report satisfies the criterion. Return exactly one verdict from Yes , No , or N/A , followed by a short report-grounded rationale. Quote the supporting report span when it is present. Do not use parametric knowledge or evidence that does not appear in the submitted report. Preserve the supplied criterion identifier and expected polarity.
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个二进制标准、证据说明和有关报告材料,决定报告是否符合标准。 以简短的报告为依据。 引用支持报告的时间跨度。 不使用所提交的报告中没有的参数化知识或证据。 保留所提供的标准标识符和预期的极性。

blocks.en: H.1 Report Organization
blocks.zh: H.1 报告组织

blocks.en:
A valid report separates what the source video shows from what external evidence adds.
Each timeline section contains an absolute interval, an audiovisual note, and representative media.
Research findings cite external sources and state their relation to one or more video moments.
Comparisons and corrections retain uncertainty when sources disagree.
The interface lets a reader move from a note to the corresponding video time and from a claim to its cited source.
Figure 6 shows these elements in one generated report.
blocks.zh:
一份有效的报告将源视频显示的内容与外部证据补充的内容区分开来.
每个时间表部分包含绝对间隔、视听说明和具有代表性的媒体。
研究结果引用了外部来源,并说明了它们与一个或多个视频时刻的关系。
当来源有分歧时,比较和校正仍有不确定性。
界面让一个读者从注解到相应的视频时间,从声称到引用的来源.
图6在一份生成的报告中显示了这些要素。

blocks.en:
Figure 6: Four views of an interactive report for the pendant-light safety task.
The interface aligns the audiovisual timeline with research findings, multimodal media, claim-level citations, and source records.
blocks.zh:
图 6: 4种观点,即关于点亮安全任务的交互式报告.
该界面使视听时间表与研究结果、多式联运媒体、索赔一级的引用和来源记录相一致。

blocks.en: H.2 Common Report Failures
blocks.zh: H.2 共同报告失败

blocks.en:
Polished but incomplete. Some reports have strong hierarchy, imagery, and interaction, yet omit most evidence-map facts and comparisons.
This pattern motivates separate content and presentation dimensions.
blocks.zh:
有波兰语,但不完整。 有些报告有很强的层次、图像和相互作用,但忽略了大多数证据图事实和比较。
这种模式激发了不同的内容和表述层面。

blocks.en:
Source lists without claim support. Some reports contain many links, but the cited pages do not entail the nearby claims or are never connected to a source-video moment.
This pattern motivates separate citation count, closure, authority, and support directions.
blocks.zh:
没有索赔证明的来源清单。 有些报告载有许多链接,但所引用的页并不包含附近的主张,也从未与源视频瞬间连接.
这种模式激励了单独的引用计数、关闭、权威和支持方向。

blocks.en:
Transcript substitution. Some agents summarize speech and search its keywords without inspecting visible objects, charts, interfaces, motion, or other videos.
This pattern can produce a plausible report while bypassing the audiovisual evidence that defines the task.
blocks.zh:
转写替代。 一些特工汇总语音并搜索其关键词,而不检查可见对象,图表,界面,运动或其他视频.
这种模式可以在绕过界定任务的视听证据的同时产生可信的报告。

blocks.en:
Research that never reaches the report. Long trajectories may open useful sources and inspect relevant media, but the final artifact can still omit the resulting facts or relations.
This pattern motivates evaluating evidence integration in the delivered report and analyzing process traces separately.
blocks.zh:
研究从未达到报告。 长轨可能打开有用的来源并检查相关的介质,但最终的文物仍然可以忽略由此产生的事实或关系.
这种模式促使评价将证据纳入已交付报告的情况,并分别分析过程痕迹。

blocks.en: Appendix I Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录一 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en:
OmniDR-Bench currently covers 50 tasks across 19 subcategories, and future versions can collect more requests directly from users to expand task, scenario, and language coverage.
Some evaluation directions reflect capabilities emphasized by the reference skills, although scoring uses only the final report and Table 5 compares several skill subsets.
Future work should develop more general and efficient skills, tools, and subagents that transfer across agent frameworks.
The current report interface uses a relatively fixed two-pane layout for audiovisual notes, research insights, and citations, which can be extended with richer structures and interactions.
Finally, this task can require hundreds of agent steps, so training and releasing capable open-source models remains important for the research community.
blocks.zh:
OmniDR-Bench目前涵盖了19个子类的50项任务,未来的版本可以直接从用户那里收集更多的请求,以扩展任务,情景,以及语言覆盖.
一些评价方向反映了参考技能所强调的能力,虽然评分只使用最后报告,表5比较了若干技能子集。
今后的工作应发展更普遍、更有效的技能、工具和子代理人,以跨越代理框架进行转让。
本次报告界面采用相对固定的两层布局,用于视听说明、研究见解和引文,可通过更丰富的结构和互动加以扩展。
最后,这项任务可能需要数百个代理步骤,因此培训和释放有能力的开源模型对于研究界仍然很重要.
